decisions.statement: The unit running the watch is simple rather than a timer.
Repeated starts are counted over no window.
A round of takes landing is what says this watch is working.
The window holds three beats, so two missed rounds are not yet broken.
A watch that starts over and over without a round landing reads as broken.
A watch left again on a file changing lands a round and reads as well.
A watch failing all night keeps on.
The sites the readings are carried to are named by the watch rather than here.
The timers carrying these readings run whatever this service does.

definition: the service taking Alan's day readings again the moment his day changes
